div.head: Duns 3.3
div.ab: Et perdant omne quod suum est, si iniustum (iudicium) iudicent; uel se adlegient, quod rectius nescierunt.
Ðolien ealles ðæs hy agon, gyf hi woh tæcen; oððe geladian hi, þæt hi bet ne cuðon.
Sie sollen alles was sie haben verlieren, wenn sie Ungerechtes anordnen; oder sie mögen sich reinigen [durch Eid], dass sie [es] nicht besser wussten.
They shall lose all that they have if they direct what is unjust; or they may clear themselves [by oath] that they did not know better.
They must suffer the loss of all they have, if they behave unjustly; or they may exculpate themselves [by showing] that they did not know better.
div.note: Liebermann prefers the Quadripartitus reading without ‘(iudicium)’, which is only in MS R. Liebermann compares III Eg 3.
